title: NBI chief details 3 more ‘misdeclared’ Sara Duterte properties

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) Director Melvin Matibag on Thursday detailed three more alleged properties of Vice President Sara Duterte that were supposedly misdeclared in her Statements of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth (SALN). In a press conference on Thursday, Matibag mentioned properties in Davao and Paranaque City supposedly belonging to the vice president and her husband, Atty. Man Carpio. According to Matibag, the Davao Prime Bistro restaurant, which was named by Carpio, listed a P10 million acquisition cost. However, he noted that its assessed value was only P82,000.
